description: Occasionally I have deep conversations (surprised?) where literature comes up and someone will ask, "What are the most impactful books you've ever read?" I thought I might offer a glimpse into my head and share a few good reads, and what they've meant to me. Undaunted Courage, Stephen Ambrose Possibly my favorite book of all
